welcome.heading: Ansuf ɣer Sloth OS!
welcome.text: Kra n yesteqsiyen arurad, syin aselkim-ik ad yehyi. Tzemreḍ ad tbeddleḍ kullec ticki.
look.colors_hint: Sit ɣef yiwen, ad twaliḍ imir-nni amek yettban. Tzemreḍ ad t-tbeddleḍ ticki deg yiɣewwaren n unagraw.
look.taskbar: Amek ara yili ufeggag n twuriwin?
layout.windows10.name: Windows 10
layout.windows10.description: Umuɣ n usenker d tignitin ɣer zelmeḍ
layout.windows11.name: Windows 11
layout.windows11.description: Umuɣ n usenker d tignitin di tlemmast
layout.mac.name: Am macOS
layout.mac.description: Afeggag d asawen, dock yettɛummen d akessar
security.heading: Melmi ara k-d-isuter uselkim-ik awal uffir?
security.text: Kra n yiɣewwaren (am usebded n wahilen) ttuteren awal-ik uffir. Akka yiwen ur yezmir ad ibeddel aselkim-ik war ma teẓriḍ.
security.recommended: Kan i tɣawsiwin yesɛan aɣbel: ifecka n usekles, iseqdacen, asekker (yeshel)
security.not_admin: Siwa amiḍan n unedbal i izemren ad ibeddel aya.
security.autologin: Tuqqna tawurmant: srid ɣer tnarit war awal uffir
security.later: Ticki tzemreḍ ad t-tesbeddeḍ deg Sloth Center (Amiḍan d tɣellist).
sharing.heading: Ɛiwen ahilen n Windows ad kkren seg tikkelt tamezwarut ɣer yal yiwen
sharing.text: Mi ara tsekkreḍ ahil neɣ urar n Windows, Sloth OS ad yaf iman-is aɣewwar s wayes yetteddu. Ma tsurgeḍ, ad nebḍu s war isem aɣewwar i yeddan, akken ad yekker seg tikkelt tamezwarut ula deg yiselkimen-nniḍen n Sloth OS.
sharing.what: Ala wa i yettwaznen: aɣewwar (amedya «askar udlif aqbur»), amfaras n tkarḍa-k tudlift, d udsil n wahil ur nezmir ad d-nerr isem-is. Ulac ayen nniḍen ara yeffɣen seg uselkim-ik: mačči isem-ik, mačči ifuyla-k, mačči isem n wahil, mačči melmi d acḥal i t-tesqedceḍ.
sharing.later: Tzemreḍ ad t-tbeddleḍ ticki melmi i k-yehwa deg Sloth Center. Iɣewwaren yeddan deg yiselkimen nniḍen ad ten-tawiḍ ɣas akken.
windows.heading: Ad d-nawi ifuyla-k seg Windows?
windows.text: Aselkim-a yesɛa daɣen Windows. Nezmer ad d-nnɣel ifuyla-k da; Windows ur yettbeddil ara, nɣer kan seg-s.
windows.bookmarks: Ticraḍ n iminig (deg yiwen ufaylu deg tnarit i yezmer ad t-yekter yiminig-ik)
windows.onedrive: Ifuyla-k n OneDrive ad ten-tafeḍ deg Sloth Center, deg Amiḍan d tɣellist → Aklas deg usigna.
windows.done: Yemmed: {count} n ifuyla seg Windows llan da tura.
windows.failed_some: {count} n ifuyla ur ttwanɣalen ara (amedya ixesṛen neɣ yettwasekkṛen).
windows.nospace: Ulac ugar n tallunt tilellit: ilaq {need}, ilellit {free}. Fren drus n ikaramen.
windows.locked: Ameskar n Windows yettwawgelhen (BitLocker), ur yezmir ara ad yettwaɣer. Ma tesriḍ ifuyla, sens BitLocker deg Windows neɣ nɣel-iten ɣer tsarut USB.
windows.none: Ulac ifuyla n Windows ara d-nawi deg uselkim-a.
windows.failed: Ur yezmir ara ad yeldi umeskar n Windows. Sekker Windows syin sens-it akk (Sens, mačči Ales asekker), sakin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen seg Sloth Center (Ideɣraren).
category.multiple: Tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ aṭas, neɣ ula yiwen.
category.browser.name: Iminig web
category.browser.hint: S yis ara tiniggeḍ deg internet. Mebla iminig, ur tettizmireḍ ara ad teldiḍ ismal web.
category.office.name: Lbiru
category.office.hint: Iḍrisen, tifelwin n umsiḍen, tisekniyin. Yettali daɣen ifuyla n Word d Excel.
category.media.name: Aẓawan d tvidyut
category.media.hint: Urar n yisura, tvidyutin d uẓawan.
category.chat.name: Adiwenni
category.chat.hint: Iznan, isawalen s taɣect d tvidyut.
category.games.name: Uraren
category.games.hint: Tiḥuna d yisekkaren n wuraren. Uraren d yiseɣzanen n Windows ddun ula mebla nsen.
category.creative.name: Asnulfu
category.creative.hint: Aseẓreg n tewlafin, asuneɣ, aseẓreg n tvidyut, asekles.

app.windows_badge: Ahil n Windows · yettwasbedd deffir n umarag
category.windows_note: Amarag tura yessidir kan imsekkiren n wuraren n Windows (Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect…). Asebded-nsen ad yili deg taggara n umarag: ad ldin yiwen yiwen, ad ten-tfakkeḍ am deg Windows.
done.windows_hint: Imsebdad n yihilen n Windows ttwasidren ({names}). Tura ad ldin yiwen yiwen: fakk yal asebded am deg Windows. Allus n usekker ad yili deg taggara.
done.windows_continue: Kemmel ɣer usebded n yihilen n Windows
done.windows_finished: Kullec yewjed, ula d ihilen n Windows! Deffir n wallus n usekker, kullec ad d-yettwasali akken iwata.
offline.text: Ulac tuqqna ɣer internet. Qqen ɣer uẓeṭṭa akken ad tesbeddeḍ isnasen.
nobrowser.title: Ur tferneḍ ara iminig
nobrowser.text: Mebla iminig, ur tettizmireḍ ara ad teldiḍ ismal web. Tetḥeqqeḍ?

error.not_authorized: Ur d-nwi ara tasiregt n usebded.
error.checksum: Afaylu yettwasdren yexsar, ihi ur yebdid ara.

done.some_failed: Qrib ifuk. Kra n yisnasen ur ttwasbedden ara:

done.restart_hint: Ales asekker n uselkim akken ad d-alint akk teɣzinin timaynutin akken iwata.
desktop.comment: Sebded iminig, isnasen n tnarit, imeɣri n umidya d wiyaḍ, fren asentel n yiniten
done.support: Sloth OS d baṭel, yettwaxdam deg wakud ilelli. Ma yeɛǧeb-ik, tzemreḍ ad tɛiwneḍ asnefli-ines s ubiṛu: ko-fi.com/slothos
